claim_boundary.allowed: A fixed-text, fixed-shape QNN/HTP deployment test derived from the exact experiment-0013 controlled ONNX representation.
forbidden: calling mixed QNN/CPU fallback full HTP
erasing experiment 0013's immutable preliminary waveform-screen failure

host_gate.runtime_version: ONNX Runtime 1.27.1 with the experiment-0010 a08e17 Pad-selector backport
host_gate.pass_rule: Session creation and fixed-input inference must succeed with all optimized nodes assigned to QNN and no CPU-provider node events. Session creation failure or one retained CPU node fails the gate.

rewrite_policy.allowed: Only a bounded standard-operator rewrite directly tied to named unsupported nodes or fixed-contract control-flow lowering, with complete structural provenance and same-runtime CPU equivalence evidence.
forbidden_without_new_authorization: switching to the rejected sherpa graph

cpu_equivalence_gate.reference: the source controlled ONNX executed by the same host ONNX Runtime CPU build on identical fixed inputs

htp_output_gate.separation: Physical accelerator execution, provider assignment, numerical/acoustic fidelity, latency, memory, and listening observations are independent claims.
